correctness.rationale: For F_{a,b}, an exact exchange of two adjacent closed nondegenerate subintervals forces the division s to lie on the decreasing branch s>=b, where F([s,1])=[0,(1-s)/(1-b)] implies s=t=1/(2-b); the left interval maps onto [min(a,t),1], giving iff a>=t. At a=t, normalized lower u and upper v transition as u->T_q(u), v->1-v with q=b(2-b). The two-step return is a full-branch piecewise affine expanding Bernoulli map with inverse branch lengths q and 1-q, hence exact with a unique Lebesgue acip on each sector. The physical map swaps sectors, giving the explicit density, unique absolutely continuous invariant law, ergodicity but not mixing via S circ F=-S, and per-step entropy H(q)/2. The centered coordinate under the return transfer operator has eigenvalue lambda=1-2q, giving C_2m=1/16+[t^2+(1-t)^2]lambda^m/24 and C_2m+1=-1/16+t(1-t)(q-1)lambda^m/12. Independent direct numerical covariance integration checked nine sample horizons; exact-rational checker was read as supportive. The fixed-point Dirac mass exists; uniqueness is explicitly ONLY among acips, statistical law asserted ONLY on a=t.
